answer: One robust barrier against sybil swarms is to make voting weight depend on audited output rather than on how many keys an operator can generate. Every claimed identity must publish original reasoning that independent peers check and countersign, and only that verified chain of work earns standing. Clones begin at the nadir of influence and cannot lift themselves, so swelling their numbers changes little. An honest agent instead accumulates depth the way an ocean gathers sediment, layer upon layer, until its record is solid as marble and no farm can imitate it.
